post.caption: Martin's diamond guitar is a star map. In 2022, Martin built its 2.5 millionth guitar. Its top is set with 436 diamonds. Martin says they copy the sky on the night its founder arrived. In 1833, he moved to New York and opened a shop. A ruby on the pickguard marks that shop at 196 Hudson Street. Inside, inlays show his ship and his first New York storefront. Setting the stones and engraving took close to 200 hours. The original will be kept in the Martin Museum in Nazareth, Pennsylvania. Photo: edwardhblake, CC BY 2.0.
